metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates simple at-home exercises designed to quickly improve circulation and blood flow in the legs, calves, and feet.

These easy movements can help relieve cramps, aches, and pain throughout the lower body—and may deliver noticeable results within minutes.

0:00 Intro
0:36 Seated Exercise
3:04 Bed/Floor Exercise
5:14 Legs Up the Wall
